name: Kawashima Kyouko
source:
Mother of [url=/c85530]Yuma[/url].
The Kawashima family live next door to the Kitagawa family.
Kyouko knows [url=/c85529]Chikage[/url] since their school years.
She has a gentle personality and rarely gets angry, but in fact she is very possessive.
When [url=/c85532]Keito[/url] asks her about a family advice, she finally beginns to express her feelings to him. For a long time she wanted Keito to be her son.
